column1: # After inflation, California's average employer family premium rose 16% from 2016 to 2025; median household income rose 19%.

# Source: Index, 2016 = 100, both in 2025 dollars: the premium converted with CPI-U, income as Census publishes it in constant dollars. Premium: AHRQ MEPS-IC, private-sector employers, table II.D.1. Income: Census CPS ASEC Table H-8B, three-year averages. Income covers all households, not only those with employer plans.
